_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a Trade extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers would be built from pulse condition-codes (freight_cost_spike, port_congestion...) + active diagnosis ids. In Trade the CONDITION-CODES never textually equal an activation.diagnosticTrigger; this table bridges them via the evidence-family -> requiredFamily -> diagnosis chain. As in Finance, Trade activation.diagnosticTriggers ARE diagnosis ids, so active diagnosis ids already self-match; the condition-code map is the part that is strictly required.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(trade-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L116-147)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L158-164)--> diagnosis id --(trade.json issues[]._authored circuit)--> circuit nodeIds --(these nodeIds are activations whose diagnosticTriggers are themselves diagnosis ids)--> diagnosticTriggers. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data). The condition-codes section adds the pulse-engine family hop.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate, which is requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, NOT primaryIndicators). A condition that is only a diagnosis secondaryConfirmation but does not emit that diagnosis requiredFamily is listed under secondaryDiagnoses and NOT folded (bias against over-marking). See shipping_delay.
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from trade.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinanceAndEnergy: (1) Trade inlines classification like Finance (no dedicated classify() over a distinct exogenous vocabulary as Energy has), and its condition-codes ARE the contract indicator tokens. (2) Trade activation.diagnosticTriggers are DIAGNOSIS IDs (like Finance, unlike Energy free-text), so the diagnoses map is largely redundant for direct matching. (3) KEY TRADE DIFFERENCE: Trade has NO generic _stress_ skip. Its stress-like tokens (structural_stress, supply_high_stress) DO ground, folding into SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE via the structural_event family (SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE is the one catchAllBlocked:false diagnosis). In Finance the _stress_ tokens were explicitly excluded and unmapped. (4) Trade emits a macro_event family (from macro_shock) that NO contract consumes (dead-end) - SAME as Finance. (5) Trade also classifies uppercase event tokens STRAIT_DISRUPTION / PORT_DISRUPTION that ground to PORT_BLOCKADE via family (Energy-like exogenous tokens). (6) ORPHAN COUNT: Energy 1, Finance 3, TRADE 0 - every activation carrying diagnosticTriggers is authored into at least one issue circuit, so nothing is stranded.

unmapped._activationsWithTriggersNote: EMPTY (0 orphans). Every trade.json activation that carries diagnosticTriggers appears in at least one issue._authored circuit, so all are reachable and none would be perpetually flagged for extinction. This is the KEY TRADE DIFFERENCE from Finance (3 orphans: SMA/AMY/INS) and Energy (1 orphan). Nothing needs authoring before extinction is safe to run.
